# Class exercise - the questions (written by C:/DE10_solutions/class_exercise/gen.py, do not edit).
# [Qnn] NAME | title | npub n [| steps n];  B: board;  Pk: printed for login numbers with pub = k;
# with steps: Sk: the screen of step k (step 0 = login, in run.ps1);  without: L: question, F: answer format

[Q01] GATE | Which gate is hidden in the board? | npub 1 | steps 4 | flat
B: A = SW9, B = SW8 (HEX3, HEX2).  Y = LEDG0 (green).  Your answer goes on SW3..SW0.
S1: GOAL: meet the board. A gate is hidden in it: inputs A = SW9, B = SW8, output Y = LEDG0.
S1: Put A B = 0 0 (SW9 and SW8 down). Is the green light LEDG0 on?
S1: ANSWER: SW0 up if LEDG0 is on, SW0 down if it is off.
S2: GOAL: the whole truth table of the gate.
S2: Try A B = 00, 01, 10, 11 (SW9 SW8) and write Y for each row.
S2: ANSWER: SW0 = Y at 00,  SW1 = Y at 01,  SW2 = Y at 10,  SW3 = Y at 11.
S3: GOAL: name the gate. Compare your truth table with what each gate does.
S3: ANSWER - first put SW3 SW2 SW1 SW0 all DOWN, then raise only the switches of your gate:
S3:    AND = (all down)    OR = SW0    XOR = SW1    NAND = SW1 + SW0    NOR = SW2    XNOR = SW2 + SW0

[Q02] SIGMA | Minterms and maxterms of a hidden F | npub 1 | steps 6 | flat
B: A = SW9, B = SW8, C = SW7 (HEX3 HEX2 HEX1).  F = LEDG0 (green).  Your answer goes on SW3..SW0.
S1: GOAL: meet F. It has three inputs: A = SW9, B = SW8, C = SW7. F = LEDG0.
S1: Put A B C = 0 0 0 (SW9, SW8, SW7 down). Is LEDG0 on?
S1: ANSWER: SW0 up if LEDG0 is on, SW0 down if it is off.
S2: GOAL: the first half of the truth table - the 4 rows where A = 0. Keep SW9 DOWN.
S2: 1. Set SW8 SW7 like this, and write down LEDG0 (on = 1) for each row:
S2:       row 000: SW8 down, SW7 down      row 001: SW8 down, SW7 up
S2:       row 010: SW8 up,   SW7 down      row 011: SW8 up,   SW7 up
S2: 2. Copy the 4 lights to the right switches (up = 1):
S2: ANSWER: SW0 = row 000,  SW1 = row 001,  SW2 = row 010,  SW3 = row 011.
S3: GOAL: the second half - the 4 rows where A = 1. Keep SW9 UP.
S3: 1. Set SW8 SW7 like this, and write down LEDG0 (on = 1) for each row:
S3:       row 100: SW8 down, SW7 down      row 101: SW8 down, SW7 up
S3:       row 110: SW8 up,   SW7 down      row 111: SW8 up,   SW7 up
S3: 2. Copy the 4 lights to the right switches (up = 1):
S3: ANSWER: SW0 = row 100,  SW1 = row 101,  SW2 = row 110,  SW3 = row 111.
S4: GOAL: minterms. A row where F = 1 is a MINTERM: F = SIGMA(those row numbers).
S4: Count the rows of your table where F = 1.
S4: ANSWER: the number on the switches:   1 = SW0   2 = SW1   3 = SW1+SW0   4 = SW2   5 = SW2+SW0   6 = SW2+SW1   7 = SW2+SW1+SW0
S5: GOAL: maxterms. A row where F = 0 is a MAXTERM: F = PI(those row numbers).
S5: Count the rows of your table where F = 0.
S5: ANSWER: the number on the switches:   1 = SW0   2 = SW1   3 = SW1+SW0   4 = SW2   5 = SW2+SW0   6 = SW2+SW1   7 = SW2+SW1+SW0

[Q03] TERMS | Which light is a minterm, which a maxterm? | npub 1 | steps 5 | flat
B: A = SW9, B = SW8, C = SW7 (HEX3 HEX2 HEX1).  4 terms = LEDG3..LEDG0 (green).  Your answer goes on SW3..SW0.
S1: GOAL: meet the 4 green lights. Each one is a TERM of A B C, like  A B'  or  A + C.
S1: Put A B C = 1 1 1 (SW9, SW8, SW7 up).
S1: ANSWER: copy the lights - SWi up if LEDGi is on (SW3..SW0).
S2: GOAL: ONE table of all 4 lights. Copy it to paper, go over the 8 rows once (0 = down, 1 = up),
S2: and mark the lights that are on in each row:
S2:    row (SW9 SW8 SW7)    LEDG3  LEDG2  LEDG1  LEDG0
S2:    0 0 0
S2:    0 0 1
S2:    0 1 0
S2:    0 1 1
S2:    1 0 0
S2:    1 0 1
S2:    1 1 0
S2:    1 1 1
S2: ANSWER: how many 1s in the LEDG0 column?   1 = SW0   2 = SW1   3 = SW1+SW0   4 = SW2   5 = SW2+SW0   6 = SW2+SW1   7 = SW2+SW1+SW0
S3: GOAL: the MINTERM - all three letters ANDed, like  A B' C. It is ON in only ONE row.
S3: In your table, find the column with a single 1.
S3: ANSWER: one switch up - SWi for that light (LEDGi).
S4: GOAL: the MAXTERM - all three letters ORed, like  A + B' + C. It is OFF in only ONE row.
S4: In your table, find the column with a single 0.
S4: ANSWER: one switch up - SWi for that light (LEDGi).

[Q04] MATTER | Which input does not matter? | npub 1 | steps 5 | flat
B: A = SW9, B = SW8, C = SW7 (HEX3 HEX2 HEX1).  F = LEDG0 (green).  Your answer goes on SW3..SW0.
S1: GOAL: the truth table of F. Copy it to paper, go over the 8 rows once (0 = down, 1 = up),
S1: and write F (LEDG0 on = 1) in each row:
S1:    row (SW9 SW8 SW7)    F
S1:    0 0 0
S1:    0 0 1
S1:    0 1 0
S1:    0 1 1
S1:    1 0 0
S1:    1 0 1
S1:    1 1 0
S1:    1 1 1
S1: ANSWER: how many 1s in the F column?   1 = SW0   2 = SW1   3 = SW1+SW0   4 = SW2   5 = SW2+SW0   6 = SW2+SW1   7 = SW2+SW1+SW0
S2: GOAL: does A matter? Look at pairs of rows that differ ONLY in A (the first digit):
S2:    000 - 100      001 - 101      010 - 110      011 - 111
S2: If F is different in at least one pair, A matters.
S2: ANSWER: SW0 up if A matters, SW0 down if F is the same in all 4 pairs.
S3: GOAL: does B matter? Pairs that differ ONLY in B (the middle digit):
S3:    000 - 010      001 - 011      100 - 110      101 - 111
S3: ANSWER: SW0 up if B matters, SW0 down if F is the same in all 4 pairs.
S4: GOAL: one input never changes F - find it. (Check C too: pairs 000-001, 010-011, 100-101, 110-111.)
S4: ANSWER: raise ONE switch for the input that does NOT matter:   A = SW2    B = SW1    C = SW0

[Q05] MUX | What is wired into the multiplexer? | npub 1 | steps 6 | flat
B: Select S1 = SW9, S0 = SW8.  Input C = SW7.  (HEX3 HEX2 HEX1)   Y = LEDG0 (green).   Your answer goes on SW3..SW0.
B: A 4:1 mux: S1 S0 = 00 sends D0 to Y,  01 sends D1,  10 sends D2,  11 sends D3.
S1: GOAL: meet the mux. Put S1 S0 = 0 0 (SW9, SW8 down) - now Y shows D0.
S1: Look at Y with C = 0 (SW7 down), then with C = 1 (SW7 up).
S1: ANSWER: SW0 = Y with C = 0,   SW1 = Y with C = 1   (up = on).
S2: GOAL: what is on D0? Put S1 S0 = 0 0 (SW9 down, SW8 down) - now Y shows D0.
S2: Look at Y with C = 0 (SW7 down) and with C = 1 (SW7 up):
S2:    Y 0 and 0 -> '0'     Y 1 and 1 -> '1'     Y = C (0 then 1) -> C     Y = opposite of C (1 then 0) -> C'
S2: ANSWER: '0' = all down    '1' = SW0    C = SW1    C' = SW1 + SW0
S3: GOAL: what is on D1? Put S1 S0 = 0 1 (SW9 down, SW8 up) - now Y shows D1.
S3: Look at Y with C = 0 (SW7 down) and with C = 1 (SW7 up):
S3:    Y 0 and 0 -> '0'     Y 1 and 1 -> '1'     Y = C (0 then 1) -> C     Y = opposite of C (1 then 0) -> C'
S3: ANSWER: '0' = all down    '1' = SW0    C = SW1    C' = SW1 + SW0
S4: GOAL: what is on D2? Put S1 S0 = 1 0 (SW9 up, SW8 down) - now Y shows D2.
S4: Look at Y with C = 0 (SW7 down) and with C = 1 (SW7 up):
S4:    Y 0 and 0 -> '0'     Y 1 and 1 -> '1'     Y = C (0 then 1) -> C     Y = opposite of C (1 then 0) -> C'
S4: ANSWER: '0' = all down    '1' = SW0    C = SW1    C' = SW1 + SW0
S5: GOAL: what is on D3? Put S1 S0 = 1 1 (SW9 up, SW8 up) - now Y shows D3.
S5: Look at Y with C = 0 (SW7 down) and with C = 1 (SW7 up):
S5:    Y 0 and 0 -> '0'     Y 1 and 1 -> '1'     Y = C (0 then 1) -> C     Y = opposite of C (1 then 0) -> C'
S5: ANSWER: '0' = all down    '1' = SW0    C = SW1    C' = SW1 + SW0

[Q06] DECODER | A decoder: which light is which output? | npub 6 | steps 6 | flat
B: A = SW9, B = SW8 (HEX3 HEX2).  The decoder's 4 outputs = LEDG3..LEDG0 - in a hidden order.  Answer on SW3..SW0.
P0: Your function for the last step:  F = SIGMA(0, 1)  - F = 1 when A B = 00 or 01.
P1: Your function for the last step:  F = SIGMA(0, 2)  - F = 1 when A B = 00 or 10.
P2: Your function for the last step:  F = SIGMA(0, 3)  - F = 1 when A B = 00 or 11.
P3: Your function for the last step:  F = SIGMA(1, 2)  - F = 1 when A B = 01 or 10.
P4: Your function for the last step:  F = SIGMA(1, 3)  - F = 1 when A B = 01 or 11.
P5: Your function for the last step:  F = SIGMA(2, 3)  - F = 1 when A B = 10 or 11.
S1: GOAL: meet the decoder. For every input row exactly ONE output is on (one-hot).
S1: Put A B = 0 0 (SW9 down, SW8 down). Which green light is on?
S1: ANSWER: one switch up - SWi for the light LEDGi that is on.   Write it down: row 00 -> LEDG?
S2: GOAL: the output of row 01.
S2: Put A B = 0 1 (SW9 down, SW8 up). Which green light is on?
S2: ANSWER: one switch up - SWi for the light LEDGi that is on.   Write it down: row 01 -> LEDG?
S3: GOAL: the output of row 10.
S3: Put A B = 1 0 (SW9 up, SW8 down). Which green light is on?
S3: ANSWER: one switch up - SWi for the light LEDGi that is on.   Write it down: row 10 -> LEDG?
S4: GOAL: the output of row 11.
S4: Put A B = 1 1 (SW9 up, SW8 up). Which green light is on?
S4: ANSWER: one switch up - SWi for the light LEDGi that is on.   Write it down: row 11 -> LEDG?
S5: GOAL: logic using a decoder. F = SIGMA(...) = an OR of the decoder outputs of its rows (see above).
S5: Look at your notes: which light belongs to each row of F?
S5: ANSWER: raise the TWO switches of those lights (SWi for LEDGi).
